zh.title: 美國空軍結束戴維斯-蒙森基地A-10戰機近半世紀飛行任務
zh.summary: 美國空軍於2026年7月29日完成A-10C攻擊機在亞利桑那州戴維斯-蒙森空軍基地的最後一次飛行，正式結束該機在該基地近五十年的飛行營運。作為A-10飛行員正式訓練單位的第357戰鬥機中隊已於4月畢業最後一期學員。空軍規劃將部分A-10服役期延長至2030年，戴維斯-蒙森基地將轉型接納特種作戰與救援單位。
body: 美國空軍於2026年7月29日完成A-10C攻擊機（Thunderbolt II）在亞利桑那州戴維斯-蒙森空軍基地的最後一次飛行。這項最後飛行任務劃下了該基地近五十年A-10機隊營運的句點。當天基地官兵與當地社群領袖聚集於飛行線觀看飛行，飛機降落後依傳統接受水門禮與最後致敬。

駐紮於戴維斯-蒙森空軍基地的第357戰鬥機中隊是該基地最後一個現役A-10單位，長期擔任該型機的正式訓練單位。該中隊已於2026年4月3日畢業最後一期A-10飛行員學員，正式結束培養美軍所有該型機飛行員的訓練管道。退役的飛機將移交至同一機場（DMA）內的第309航太維護與再生群儲存。戴維斯-蒙森基地自2024年2月起開始將A-10戰機送往封存，第354戰鬥機中隊與第355作戰支援中隊已先後於2024年9月和2025年4月解編。
戴維斯-蒙森空軍基地目前正在進行任務轉型，未來將以搜救任務以及由佛羅里達州霍爾伯特機場遷入的空軍特種作戰司令部第492特種作戰翼為核心。該單位將為亞利桑那州南部帶來OA-1K、MC-130J及特種戰術中隊。
儘管戴維斯-蒙森基地的飛行任務告一段落，美國空軍的A-10機隊將繼續服役。空軍部長Troy Meink於2026年4月20日表示，為了在新型飛機產量提升期間維持空軍戰力，空軍將把部分A-10機隊的服役期限延長至2030年。依據現行規劃，最後運作A-10的單位將包含駐紮於喬治亞州穆迪空軍基地的第23戰鬥機群所屬中隊，以及密蘇里州懷特曼空軍基地的預備役單位。

en.title: US Air Force Ends Five Decades of A-10 Flights at Davis-Monthan Base
en.summary: The United States Air Force completed its final A-10C Thunderbolt II sortie from Davis-Monthan Air Force Base in Arizona on July 29, 2026, ending nearly five decades of A-10 flight operations at the location. The 357th Fighter Squadron, which served as the formal training unit for A-10 pilots, graduated its final class in April 2026. While the base shifts its mission toward hosting Air Force Special Operations Command units, official plans announced by Secretary of the Air Force Troy Meink will extend the operational service of remaining A-10 squadrons at other bases through 2030.
body: The United States Air Force conducted the final flight of the A-10C Thunderbolt II from Davis-Monthan Air Force Base in Arizona on July 29, 2026, bringing an end to nearly 50 years of A-10 flight operations at the facility. Service members and local civic leaders gathered on the flight line to observe the final sortie, which was greeted upon landing with a traditional water spray salute.

The 357th Fighter Squadron was the last active-duty A-10 unit based at Davis-Monthan Air Force Base and served as the primary formal training unit for the aircraft type. The squadron graduated its final class of A-10 pilots on April 3, 2026, marking the conclusion of the training pipeline that produced all A-10 pilots for the service. Aircraft retiring from the base are being transferred to the 309th Aerospace Maintenance and Regeneration Group located on the same airfield. Storage operations began in February 2024, followed by the inactivation of the 354th Fighter Squadron in September 2024 and the 355th Operations Support Squadron in April 2025.

Davis-Monthan Air Force Base is undergoing a operational transition structured around rescue missions and the arrival of the 492nd Power Projection Wing, an Air Force Special Operations Command unit relocating from Hurlburt Field in Florida. The relocation will introduce OA-1K, MC-130J, and special tactics squadrons to the Southern Arizona facility.

Although training operations at Davis-Monthan Air Force Base have concluded, the broader A-10 fleet will remain active longer than previously anticipated. On April 20, 2026, Secretary of the Air Force Troy Meink announced that the service would extend A-10 operations through 2030 to maintain combat capability. Under current operational plans, the final remaining A-10 units will include the 74th and 75th Fighter Squadrons at Moody Air Force Base in Georgia and the 303rd Fighter Squadron at Whiteman Air Force Base in Missouri.

zh.title: 俄羅斯首架量產型MC-21-310客機完成首飛
zh.summary: 俄羅斯首架量產型MC-21-310客機於2026年8月3日從位於西伯利亞伊爾庫茨克的聯合航空製造公司設施起飛，成功完成歷時1小時23分鐘的首飛。該機採用俄製PD-14發動機及國產零部件，飛行期間最高速度達每小時600公里，飛行高度達6000公尺。
body: 俄羅斯首架量產型MC-21-310客機於2026年8月3日完成首飛。該架客機自聯合航空製造公司（UAC）位於西伯利亞伊爾庫茨克的設施起飛，空中飛行時間為1小時23分鐘。試飛期間，飛機最大飛行速度達到每小時600公里，最高飛行高度達6000公尺。
MC-21-310為該型客機國產化版本，搭載俄羅斯自製的PD-14發動機，並大幅提高本土零件使用比例。截至2026年8月，MC-21-310仍處於認證階段。據俄羅斯媒體引述聯合航空製造公司官員說法，伊爾庫茨克廠房內目前另有18架處於不同組裝階段的MC-21-310客機。

en.title: First Production Model of Russia's MC-21-310 Completes Maiden Flight
en.summary: Russia's first production MC-21-310 aircraft completed its maiden flight on August 3, 2026, taking off from United Aircraft Corporation's (UAC) facility in Irkutsk, Siberia. During the one-hour-and-23-minute initial test flight, the aircraft reached a maximum speed of 600 kilometers per hour and an altitude of 6,000 meters. The MC-21-310 is powered by Russian-made PD-14 engines and incorporates a higher proportion of domestic components. As of August 2026, the aircraft remains in its certification process, with UAC reporting 18 additional MC-21-310 aircraft in various stages of completion at the plant.
body: Russia’s first production MC-21-310 aircraft completed its maiden flight on August 3, 2026, taking off from United Aircraft Corporation’s (UAC) facility in Irkutsk, Siberia. The aircraft remained airborne for one hour and 23 minutes, reaching a speed of 600 kilometers per hour (372 miles per hour) and an altitude of 6,000 meters (19,685 feet).

The MC-21-310 is powered by Russian-made PD-14 engines and utilizes domestic components as part of an import-substitution program. As of August 2026, the MC-21-310 is undergoing certification, with UAC officials cited by Russian media indicating that 18 aircraft are currently in different states of completion at the Irkutsk plant.

zh.title: 美國航空選定DO CO為希斯洛機場常態餐飲商
zh.summary: 據 Simple Flying 報導，美國航空在經歷長達 5 個月的臨時替代方案後，已選定 DO & CO 擔任其於希斯洛機場的常態餐飲服務供應商。隨著新的長期合約生效，搭乘美國航空相關航班的旅客預期將能迎來機上餐單的全面恢復。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，美國航空（American Airlines）在經歷了長達 5 個月的臨時過渡與替代方案後，目前已在希斯洛機場（Heathrow）正式確定常態性的機上餐飲供應商。餐飲服務業者 DO & CO 已接手擔任美國航空於希斯洛機場的長期餐飲承包商。
隨著 DO & CO 開始接管負責美國航空在希斯洛機場的長期餐飲服務，搭乘該航空公司航班的旅客預期將能迎來機上餐單的全面恢復與完整供應。這項新合約的推行，正式結束了該航司在希斯洛機場為期 5 個月的過渡性餐飲安排。

en.title: American Airlines Names DO & CO as Permanent Heathrow Caterer
en.summary: According to aviation news reported by Simple Flying, American Airlines has selected DO & CO to serve as its permanent catering contractor at London Heathrow Airport, effectively ending a five-month transitional period during which the carrier relied on stopgap catering measures. As DO & CO officially takes over responsibility as the airline's permanent caterer at Heathrow, passengers traveling with American Airlines can expect a full restoration of the carrier's inflight menu offerings.
body: According to a report by Simple Flying, American Airlines has secured DO & CO as its permanent inflight catering provider at Heathrow. The appointment comes after a five-month period during which the airline relied on temporary stopgap catering measures at the airport.

As DO & CO assumes responsibility as the permanent caterer for American Airlines at Heathrow, passengers traveling on the carrier's flights can expect a full restoration of the inflight menu. The arrival of the long-term caterer concludes five months of interim solutions for the airline's catering operations at the hub.
